title: Chapter 1 v1: corrected Adzom-based reading with a scoped comparative apparatus
scope: Preserve the Adzom diplomatic reading and all accepted restorations; distinguish main text, source annotations and editorial notes. Use existing A/B/S/W comparison and already integrated scan evidence. No claim of exhaustive witness collation or reconstructed original.
unresolved_readings_allowed: Yes, when localized, visibly qualified and linked to the evidence. An unexamined span must not be called unreadable or collated.
packet_note: These eight batch records await integration/disposition at the audited commit. Prepared labels can lag completed reader output. Output existence, hashes and parse status must be checked before integration; this count is not eight certified readings.
definition_of_release_disposition: A locus-specific choice, rationale and existing evidence references. Previously completed research is reused. A generated generic provisional paragraph is not automatically a final-release acceptance entry.
deferred_work: Continuous comparison of all acquired scan witnesses
Common-spell normalization or an eclectic reconstructed master
Deciphering every title, caption and foreign-script glyph
Rebuilding missing historical reports without new evidence
next_step: No remaining work in the approved v1 gate after final validation and verified publication. Deferred exhaustive collation is not a v1 prerequisite; Chapter 2 has not been started.
metric_caveat: The 183 acceptance entries below are a new release checklist, not 183 wholly unreviewed scholarly loci. Workload denominators remain separate; no aggregate percentage or claimed accuracy is computed.
